goal: Content security policy review: script sources, unsafe directives and report-only rollout.
use: Content security policy review: script sources, unsafe directives and report-only rollout. Use when a page or header policy is set or changed.

steps.note: Read the policy. List each directive and its sources.
Flag unsafe directives. 'unsafe-inline' and 'unsafe-eval' weaken the policy.
Check sources. Flag wildcard and overly broad host sources.
Check rollout. A new policy should run in report-only mode first.
Report. Each directive with its gap and the fix.
